26inline constexpr std::size_t MaxLogFileBytes = 50UL * 1024 * 1024;
28inline constexpr std::size_t MaxLogFiles = 5;
29
35inline std::shared_ptr<spdlog::logger>
36makeLogger(std::string_view name, std::string_view logFile = {}) {
37 std::vector<spdlog::sink_ptr> sinks{
38 std::make_shared<spdlog::sinks::stdout_color_sink_mt>(),
39 };
40
41 if (!logFile.empty()) {
42 // A log directory that cannot be written is a deployment problem worth
43 // reporting, but it is not a reason to refuse to run: the console sink
44 // still carries every line. Letting the exception out would abort the
45 // process before it could say why.
46 try {
47 sinks.push_back(std::make_shared<spdlog::sinks::rotating_file_sink_mt>(
48 std::string(logFile), MaxLogFileBytes, MaxLogFiles));
49 } catch (const spdlog::spdlog_ex &e) {
50 spdlog::warn("Logging to console only; could not open '{}': {}", logFile,
51 e.what());
52 }
53 }
54
55 auto logger = std::make_shared<spdlog::logger>(std::string(name),
56 sinks.begin(), sinks.end());
57
58 logger->set_pattern("[%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%e] [%n] [%^%l%$] %v");
59 logger->set_level(spdlog::level::info);
60 logger->flush_on(spdlog::level::info);
61
62 return logger;
63}
